main_text.p: ADVERSARII Israelitarum Iosaphat tempore mutuis viribus conciderunt, 2.Par.20.v.22.23. Aduersarij Salomonis 1.Reg.11.v.14 23. [Aduersarius noster, 1.Pet.5.8. ]

ADVLATIO siue assentatio, κολακία, est immodica & nimia erga alterius vel praesentis vel absentis laudatio ac praedicatio nobis facta, vt illi placeamus & applaudamus. Assentator igitur est blandus inimicus.

ADVLATIONIS exempla. Core & eius complices, Numeri. Doeg Idumaeus, 1. Sam.22,9. Amalechita, 2. Sam.1,10. chab & Baana, 4.8. Absalom, 15,3. Siba, 16, 1. Sedechias Regum 22,11,2. Paral.18,10. Pseudoprophetae, 1.Reg.22. 2.Paral.18.11.Mich.3.5. Pseudoprophetae & Sacerdotes Zech.13.v.10.16. & 22.28. Ierem.6.14. & 8.11. Thren.2. niores Roboam consiliarij, 2.Paral.10. Principes Iudae 17.Hostes Iuda & Beniamin, 1.Esdr.4.14. Mamuchan, 1.16. Regis Assueri ministri, 3.4. amici Aman, eiusque Zares, 5.14. Praefecti Darij regis, Dan.6.7. Filia Herodiadis Matth.14.6. Discipuli Pharisaeorum & Herodiani, 22. Herodes Agrippa, Actor.12.3. populus adstans Herodi cionanti, v.21.22. Iudaei, 17.7. accusatores Pauli, 23.4. tullus, 24.2. Felix adulatur Iudaeis, 24,27. Festus Iudaeis 9. Agrippae, v.26. quidam schismatici Ecclesiae Romanae Rom.16.18. Adulationis punitae exempla: Core, Dathan, biron, eorumq; complices, Numer.16 v.31.32.33. Amalech ta, 2. Sam.1.15. Rechab & Baana, 4.12.
ADVLATOR cui similis, Prouerb.29.5. quàm iniqui, Psal. 3. Adulatores Regum damnantur, Ose.7.3.
ADVLTERIVM est, cùm thorus coniugalis (quod debet vnius viri cum vna muliere) à marito vel vxore violatur.

ADVLTERIVM damnatur & prohibetur, Gen.20.3.&26. Exod,20.14. Leuit.18.20.&20.10. Deut.5.18. & 22,v.23. Iudic.19,2.2. Sam.11.4. & 12.10. Iob.24.15. & 31.1. Psal.73. Prouer.5.v.3.8.20. & 6.v.24.32. Esa.57.3.&c. Ierem.2. 3.1. & 5.7. & 13.27. Ose.2.4. & 4.2. Malach.3.5. Matt.5.27. 14.3. & 19.18. Marc.10.19. Ioan.8.3.1. Corinth.6.10. 1.T. 4.3. Hebr.13.4. Iac. 4.4. Adulterium committere in corde. page.notes: The right edge of the page is partly hidden by the facing page, so the line ends there are cut off and several lines are incomplete. Lines ending "C", "Men", "Mamuchan, In", "Core, Dathan" and similar are truncated by the scan. Some words in the Psalm and Scripture references are doubtful, e.g. "Psal.73" and "Psal.12". The Greek word κολακία is transcribed as printed. The page is not complete on the right; the words cut off are not transcribed.
